title: Deportes Limache beats Cobresal to secure cup spot
seoTitle: Deportes Limache beats Cobresal to secure cup spot
subtitle: The clash that could change both teams' positions this season
excerpt: Deportes Limache heads to Lucio Fariña Stadium with confidence after a 2-0 win over Ñublense, while Cobresal fights to escape the relegation zone.
author: Daniele Morais
trending: club de deportes limache x cobresal
contentHtml:
Deportes Limache enters the Lucio Fariña Stadium with 30 points, just two behind Ñublense, and the chance to move into the qualification zone for international cups. Cobresal, on the other hand, arrives at the same stadium with 21 points, in the relegation zone, and needs points to overtake Universidad de Concepción.

Recent form of both teams

  • Deportes Limache won 2-0 at home against Ñublense on September 3, boosting squad confidence and showing defensive solidity.
  • Cobresal won 2-0 against Palestino, but remains in fifteenth place and has a history of inconsistent away performances.
  • In their last three head-to-head meetings, Deportes Limache won twice, with a 5-2 thrashing in March 2026 and a 2-0 win in October 2025.

What could influence the result

  • The home advantage favors Limache, who have been hard to beat at the Lucio Fariña Stadium.
  • Cobresal struggles to win away, being the only team in the league without a first-half win as a visitor.
  • Limache tends to score in the final minutes, with goals after the 79th minute in five of their last seven matches.

Impact on the standings and team goals

  • A win for Limache lifts the club to fifth place, tying Everton on 33 points and bringing them closer to the cup qualification zone.
  • A win for Cobresal would lift the team to 24 points, overtaking Universidad de Concepción and climbing out of the relegation zone.

Match details

  • Date and time: September 7, 2026, 20:00 (local time).
  • Venue: Lucio Fariña Stadium, in Limache.
  • Broadcast: TNT Sports and streaming platform in Chile.
  • Referee: Matías Riquelme.

Possible lineup changes

  • Deportes Limache could count on Dylan Escobar, who served a suspension, and Leonardo Valencia, recovered from a muscle injury.

With information from ToffeeWeb, RedGol, El Observador.
